title: Keeping empty battlefield control while the chain is pending
explanation: Battlefield control cannot be lost while an item is on the chain because the turn is not open. Cruel Patron, Baited Hook, Arcane Shift, and Glasc Mixologist can therefore remove the last unit and still play the resulting unit to that same controlled battlefield when their stated timing requirements are met.
